Container.Name: bulletin-worker
Container.Overview:
Processes Catholic parish bulletins with GPT and writes mass/confession/adoration times to Notion. Runs on a cron schedule inside the container.
Exists to cover the parishes whose websites block GitHub Actions' datacenter IPs but load fine from a residential connection. It does NOT regenerate export.json — the weekly GitHub Actions job rebuilds that from Notion.
Container.Description: Scheduled Catholic parish bulletin scraper feeding Notion.

Config.Name: Notion parish DB ID
Config.Description: Required. The Notion database ID holding the parishes.

Config.Name: Schedule (cron)
Config.Description: Five-field cron expression in the container's timezone. Default: Saturday 09:00, before the 14:00 UTC GitHub Actions export. Examples: '0 3 * * *' = daily 3am; '0 9 * * 6' = Saturdays 9am.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone the schedule is interpreted in.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: 'ids' = process exactly the parishes listed below. 'all' = process every enabled parish with data older than Stale days.

Config.Name: Parishes
Config.Description: Parish IDs to process when Mode=ids. Separate with spaces or commas.

Config.Name: Stale days
Config.Description: When Mode=all, only reprocess parishes whose data is older than this many days.

Config.Name: Run on start
Config.Description: 'true' runs the worker once immediately when the container starts, then follows the schedule. Handy for testing.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: 'true' downloads and extracts but writes nothing to Notion.

Config.Name: Log retention (days)
Config.Description: Delete per-run logs older than this. 0 disables pruning.
